ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.10'

about.description:
parakeet-mlx implements NVIDIA's Parakeet automatic-speech-recognition
models on top of MLX, Apple's array framework, giving Metal-accelerated
transcription on Apple Silicon. It provides a Python API and a
``parakeet-mlx`` command line entry point, and can emit word-level
timestamps and subtitle output.

The package is pure Python; the acceleration comes from its ``mlx``
dependency. Because conda-forge's mlx has no Windows build, this package
is installable on Linux and macOS only.
about.summary: NVIDIA Parakeet speech-recognition models implemented on MLX

name: parakeet-mlx
raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.5.2"

package:
  name: parakeet-mlx
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/p/parakeet-mlx/parakeet_mlx-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 6c6ba3c4d42ebf015dde515e5a83858a516add3f5b2c6bd4a7be5c4ba8bd4d02

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - parakeet-mlx = parakeet_mlx.cli:app

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools >=42
    - wheel
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - dacite >=1.9.2
    - huggingface_hub >=0.30.2
    - librosa >=0.11.0
    - mlx >=0.22.1
    - numpy >=2.2.5
    - typer >=0.15.3

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - parakeet_mlx
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - '*'
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - parakeet-mlx --help

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/senstella/parakeet-mlx
  repository: https://github.com/senstella/parakeet-mlx
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: NVIDIA Parakeet speech-recognition models implemented on MLX
  description: |
    parakeet-mlx implements NVIDIA's Parakeet automatic-speech-recognition
    models on top of MLX, Apple's array framework, giving Metal-accelerated
    transcription on Apple Silicon. It provides a Python API and a
    ``parakeet-mlx`` command line entry point, and can emit word-level
    timestamps and subtitle output.

    The package is pure Python; the acceleration comes from its ``mlx``
    dependency. Because conda-forge's mlx has no Windows build, this package
    is installable on Linux and macOS only.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - rxm7706
